mentions.name: Bloom
mentions.description: This is an open source Android app for note-taking and task management that is compatible with org-mode. It supports capture templates, app shortcuts for quick capture, sync conflict notifications with resolution by picking or merging revisions, a customizable agenda showing overdue, due soon, and upcoming events, a quick add overlay from the agenda widget, task refile by drilling into files/headings or searching, auto-archiving of done tasks, and org-attach-compliant attachments with inline image rendering including width control.
mentions.problem: Existing org-mode Android app Orgzly Revived caused friction, prompting a purpose-built replacement.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building Bloom, an open source Android app for note-taking and task management that's compatible with org-mode.
